data.body: **P1 — Bound cleanup after durable suspension or retry.** Even after `runUntilCompleteOrSuspend` selects `PENDING` or `RETRYING`, this waits for the handler and its `finally` blocks before synchronously running end hooks. A blocked cleanup or telemetry flush can consume the Lambda deadline, preventing the durable response from reaching the service. Reserve response time using `lambdaContext.getRemainingTimeInMillis()` and convert overdue cleanup into a retryable invocation failure; add low-deadline regression tests.
